scope: Binance bounded-session acceptance; economic result measured on the session timing (current_session_replay)

overlay.entry: one per continuous true state, ten completed UTC daily lows as stop

execution.session_start_schedule: frozen: research/session_schedule.json (795 primary starts, sha256 in current_session_replay)
execution.entry: price-bounded LIMIT IOC; terminal zero fills may be reconsidered on subsequent polls
execution.cold_start: reconstruct completed bars; consume the already active campaign without inferring historical fills
execution.stop: bounded cleanup; native protection survives process exit
execution.top_up: within the entry session only, IOC toward the committed campaign size after a completed cashflow audit; a macro campaign keeps the whole position inside its 3% entry stop budget; margin is added first and the deadline, stop request and quote are re-checked after it

required_dated_inputs: causal market observations and publication/availability timestamps
ordinary and conditional execution timing, spread, slippage and partial fills
dated quantity/price rules, leverage brackets, maintenance margin and liquidation costs
dated executable CNY/USDT conversions including conversion costs
account_evidence: one continuous account including unattended exposure; observation gaps cannot be interpolated into complete MDD

current_session_replay.scope: production session.run and Lifecycle on SessionExchange; not a historical order book; native execution not verified

accepted_basis.decision: The 29 missing official mark minutes on 2020-01-19 are bounded by the measured mark/trade divergence; a protection trigger inside the gap is judged negligible. This is an owner acceptance of a hindsight bound, not a complete historical path.
accepted_basis.default_trial: P6 (PRIMARY_RISK 7.5, --mark-gap bound default); same final value, fees, funding and MDD as M5 P5; source git 8c22f7c recorded in the original

current_session_replay.reproduce: python -m research.rebuild P6  (defaults: frozen primary schedule, --mark-gap bound, fee 0.00075, trigger slippage 0.001, market slippage 0.0005, participation 0.25)
current_session_replay.valuation: CNY value from FRED DEXCHUS applied from 17:00 UTC of each observation date: an ex-post valuation (H.10 is published weekly), never a decision input; USDT at USD par; 0.1% conversion each way

economic_status: base meets both targets under the owner-accepted mark-gap bound (path_complete=false); fee, slippage and depth stresses fall below 150% CAGR; economic_qualification stays NOT_MET
